$BTC's at $83,111, up 0.56% in 24 h, bounced off a high of $83,173 and held above $82,560. Volume's around 6.9k BTC, so the move isn't massive but it stayed in a tight range.

$BNB sat at $749, up 0.39% after touching $754 and staying above $744. About 56 k BNB traded, giving a modest lift.

All three kept a small gain and stayed near their day-highs, so watch if any break of those levels shows up on the next candle.

$MUB is hanging at 1,036.68 USDT, up 0.847% after nudging a high of 1,037.56 and finding support near 1,027.97. Volume's modest at ~493,610 USDT, so the move's staying in-session while markets are closed elsewhere.

All three are doing their thing around the clock, no overnight snooze.

$BTC held near $83,057, up 0.4% in 24 h. It nudged a touch higher to $83,081 before slipping back to $82,286 low, then settled just under the day's high.

$ETH closed at $2,508, gaining 0.7%. The pair swung between $2,474 and $2,518, topping out near the high before easing back into the mid-range.

$BNB led the trio at $750.35, up 1.4% with volume over 63k. It bounced from a low of $737.24 to a high of $753.86, ending the session comfortably above the day's peak.

All three showed modest upside and stayed inside tight ranges. No big surprises, just a steady climb across the board.

$BTC slipped to $82,864, down 0.45% in 24 h, bounced off a high of $83,305 and found support near $82,286. $ETH nudged lower to $2,496, a 0.28% dip, trading between $2,474 and $2,506. $BNB was the only one up, edging 0.60% to $748, after testing $751.35 and holding above $736.65. Volume was modest on BTC (≈10.4 k) and ETH (≈107 k), while BNB saw about 65 k trades. Watch $BTC's $82.3 k floor and $ETH's $2.47 k trough for any fresh moves; $BNB's upside may hinge on whether it can break past $751. Nothing wild, just a small drift across the board.

$BNB's been stuck in a narrow band, its 24-hour swing only about 1.3% versus the usual 3.2%, that's roughly a third tighter than normal. $ZEC nudged down a touch, down 0.65% to $1,212.58, and its daily range narrowed to 4.27% from a typical 7.3%, so it's somewhat tighter. Meanwhile $ETH stayed pretty flat, up 0.22% at $2,492.48, with a 1.85% swing compared to the usual 3.16%, also a bit tighter than usual. Nothing wild, just a calmer day across the board.

$BTC up 1.08% while $ETH slipped 0.69% against it, so ETH is losing relative strength. The 20-coin basket's average rose 9.63%, meaning the alts are outpacing BTC big time. BTC's modest gain can't keep up with the pack, and ETH's dip deepens the gap. Overall, the market's leaning hard toward the broader alt segment, leaving BTC trailing and ETH further behind. Nothing wild, just the alts doing the heavy lifting.

$BTC surged 2.44% to $82,670, hit a high of $83,528 before easing to a low of $80,543. Volume pushed past 13k BTC, worth about $1.08 B in quote.

$ETH jumped 2.876% to $2,485, topped $2,520 and found a floor around $2,409. Roughly 229k ETH traded, moving $569 M in quote.

$BNB rose 2.663% to $740.5, peaked at $746 and dipped to $719.4. Over 101k BNB changed hands, totaling $75 M quote.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $83.5K resistance; a break could test the next swing high.

$BTC nudged up to $83,076, +0.97% in 24 h, hitting a high of $83,529 before settling near the low-end of the day's range.

$ETH slipped to $2,500, down 1.24%, with the swing between $2,406 and $2,542 showing a tighter band than Bitcoin's.

$BNB fell to $742.6, off 2.26%, trading between $717 and $761 and dragging volume under $193K.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $83,300 to $83,600 zone; a break either side could set the tone for the next session.

$ETH is at 0.03028 BTC and slipped 2.291% against $BTC. Meanwhile $BTC fell 0.737% over 24 h, but the 20-coin basket only dropped about 0.454%, so BTC outperformed the average alt. ETH's relative weakness and BTC's slight edge over the basket sum up a modestly bearish tilt for the top pair, with everything else moving in the same direction but a touch slower. Nothing wild, just a quiet slide across the board.

$BTC slipped to $81,704, down 1.71% on the day. It hit a high of $83,521 before easing back, with the low at $80,394 and about 21.8k coins changing hands.

$ETH fell harder, sliding 3.39% to $2,479. The rally capped at $2,587, then dipped to $2,406. Volume was solid, roughly 414k ETH traded.

$BNB took the biggest hit, dropping 4.46% to $734.35. It bounced off a $717 floor after peaking near $776, and around 185k BNB moved.

Watch the $BTC quote volume, still over $1.78 billion, any shift there could clue us into where the next move comes from.

$SPYB's hanging at 773.22 USDT, barely below its 778 high, down 0.579% on the hour.

Nvidia's tokenized bStock $NVDAB slipped to 230.85 USDT after touching 238.17, a 2.603% drop, with over 7.6 M USDT traded.

Circle's $CRCLB is sitting at 79.4 USDT, down 2.265% from its peak of 81.48, and volume's already 16.4 M USDT.

All three keep moving 24/7, even while the traditional markets are closed.

Just a steady night-time shuffle.

$MET surged 43.2% to $0.4615, hitting $0.5468 on the way up, while volume topped 51 M USDT. $PUMP slipped 8.9% to $0.00575, barely nudging above $0.0065 and still moving 62 M USDT. $ZEC dropped 8% to $1,211, its low was $1,194.5 and it churned over 212 M USDT. One pair roaring, two tumbling, just how the 24-hour swing looks.

$ETH slipped 0.23% against $BTC, so it's losing a bit of ground in the pair. Meanwhile $BTC dropped 1.22% in the last 24 h, while the 20-coin basket of alts actually rose about 0.38%. Bottom line: BTC's underperforming the top-traded alts, and ETH isn't gaining any relative strength versus Bitcoin. Just a modest pullback across the board.

$BTC fell to $83,200.5, down 2.79% from yesterday. It bounced off a high of $85,657.01 but couldn't hold, sliding to a low of $82,787.25. Volume sat around 20,666 BTC.

$ETH slipped 4.78% to $2,567.4. The rally peaked at $2,700.54 before retreating to $2,538.06, with 429,850 ETH changing hands.

$BNB dropped 1.27% to $769.5 after testing $780.73 and finding support near $758.57. Roughly 128,800 BNB traded.

Watch the $BTC 24-hour range break of $84,500, that level could set the tone for the next session.

$SAND surged 22.3% to $0.080, trading between $0.065 and $0.088 and pulling $42.6 M in volume. $NEAR nudged up 3% to $5.20, stayed tight around $5.25-$4.87 and logged $145 M of turnover. Meanwhile $UNI tumbled almost 10% to $7.83, its low hit $7.77 after a high of $8.69, with $82.3 M traded. The market's pushing sand-based playouts forward while the Uniswap token got left in the dust.

$BTC slid to $83,500, down 3.1% on the day, after peaking near $86,700 and testing the $83,300 low. $ETH took a bigger hit, dropping 5.4% to $2,566, with the high at $2,725 and the floor around $2,552. $BNB fell 2.3% to $767, after bouncing off a $786 top and finding support near $759.

Watch the $ETH 24-hour volume, over 435k trades moved more than $1.15 B in quote terms; any shift there could hint at the next swing.

$BTC slipped to $83,974, down 1.8% on the day, after peaking near $86,699 and finding support around $83,577. Volume held near 14.9k BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.27 B.

$ETH fell 3.3% to $2,610, hitting a high of $2,725 and a low of $2,592. Trade flow stayed strong with roughly 319k ETH changing hands, totaling about $855 M in quote volume.

$BNB dropped 2.1% to $765, after testing $786 before settling near $759. It moved about 116k BNB, generating $90.4 M in quote volume.

Watch the $BTC order book depth as it edges toward the $84,500-$85,000 range, any shift there could set the tone for the next session.

$BNB's been unusually tight, its 24-hour swing was just 1.46 % versus the typical 2.70 %, so it moved roughly half as much as usual.

$ETH also kept a low profile, trading in a 1.54 % band compared to its normal 2.60 % range, about a third tighter than it normally does.

Both pairs dipped a bit, BNB down 0.8 % and ETH off 0.6 %, but nothing wild, just a calm day on the charts.

$ETH slipped a hair, down 0.25% to $2,693.91. Its 24-hour swing was just 1.33%, about half of its usual 2.6% range, a somewhat tighter day.

$BNB fell 0.77% to $780.16, trading in a 1.46% band versus the typical 2.7% swing. That's also a bit tighter than normal.

$XRP edged up 0.47% to $1.5019, moving inside a 2.22% range compared with its average 3.85%, again somewhat tighter. Looks like the top three were all a touch more restrained than usual.

$RLC exploded up 52.5% to $0.8888, hitting a high of $1.077 after a dip down to $0.524. $FIL nudged 5.4% higher, closing at $1.1539 and staying in a tight $1.0756-$1.211 range. Meanwhile $SUI fell 2.7% to $1.1902, sliding from a high of $1.2323 to a low of $1.176. Leaders are racking up volume in the 60-30 M USDT range, while the laggard's 78 M USDT flow can't stop the drop. Just a quick heads-up on who's pulling ahead and who's slipping.

$ETH/$BTC is at 0.03155, down 0.032% versus $BTC. Meanwhile $BTC slipped 0.9% in the last 24 h. The 20-coin basket of top alts surged 5.31%, leaving $BTC trailing the average alt pack. So $BTC's underperforming while $ETH is losing a tiny bit of ground to $BTC, and the broader alt set is clearly the stronger side today. Nothing wild, just alts taking the lead.

$NVDAB is holding around 239.52 USDT, up 1.768% after nudging a high of 240.03 and testing a low near 234.87. Volume's sitting at about 5.82 M USDT, so the tokenized stock stayed busy even after NY closes.

Tesla's bStock, $TSLAB, popped to 379.17 USDT, a 1.736% gain, after swinging between 365.27 and 381.37. Roughly 4.17 M USDT traded, showing the electric-car token kept the action rolling through the night.

Circle's $CRCLB barely budged, price at 83.87 USDT, up a hair 0.012% from its low of 82.16, topping out at 85.44. Still, it pulled over 11.69 M USDT in volume, proving the tokenized stock can attract liquidity 24/7.

All three are moving while traditional markets are asleep, so you can keep an eye on them whenever you want.

$BTC up 0.34% in the last 24 h. $ETH stayed flat against BTC, eth/btc is still 0.03161, no change. The 20-coin basket jumped about 1.77%, so the alts are beating $BTC hands-down. ETH isn't gaining any ground on Bitcoin, but the broader alt set is pulling ahead. Nothing wild, just the usual spread between BTC and the rest.

$ADA's 24-hour swing hit about 11.9%, almost 1.8 times its usual daily range, that's noticeably wider than normal. It also nudged up 12.3% on the day, sitting around $0.2745.

$BNB moved within a 3% band, barely above its typical range, and was up roughly 0.7% at $791.76. Nothing crazy there.

$BTC's range stayed close to 2.2%, actually a touch tighter than its week-average, and it crept up 1.4% to $86,410.

All three tickers just did their thing; $ADA was the only one that really broke out of its norm.

$BTC jumped to $86,566.25, up 2.08% in 24 h, hit a high of $86,999.11 before easing to a low of $84,796.41. Volume sat near 9.7 k BTC, total quote about $834.5 M.

$ETH nudged higher to $2,731.71, +1.449%, brushed a peak of $2,739.50 and a trough of $2,691.23. Trades kept rolling with ~119.5 k ETH moving, $324.4 M in quote volume.

$BNB topped out at $809.99, settled at $801.62, +2.313% after a swing between $782.87 and the high. Around 107.3 k BNB changed hands, generating $85.3 M in quote volume.

All three tokens posted modest gains, each testing resistance before drifting back. Watch the next intraday swing zones around those highs and lows.

$SUI slipped around $1.21, swinging about 7.8% in the last day, that's right in line with its usual 8.6% daily band, so nothing crazy.

$BNB hovered near $789, moving only 1.64% versus its typical 2.71% range; basically a flat day for the BNB pair.

$ZEC traded at $1,331 and shifted 4.75% while it normally swings 8.46% daily, so the move was modest compared with its norm.

All three tokens stayed pretty tight, no wild swings to flag.

$CBRSB just ripped up 3.88% to 184.18 USDT, hit a high of 188.5 and bounced off a 177.3 low. Volume's solid at about 1.5 M USDT, so the tokenized stock kept the action rolling well into the night.

$SNDKB's move was almost flat, up 0.134% to 1,719 USDT, swinging between 1,715.19 and 1,719.92. Trade flow sat around 548.5 K USDT, enough to keep the 24/7 market humming without any drama.

$SPYB barely budged, up 0.017% to 770.91 USDT, range-bound 770.54-771.37 with roughly 80 K USDT changing hands. All three bStocks are doing their thing around the clock, no big surprises, just steady crypto-style trading.

$XRP's 24h swing was just 1.39 % while it usually roams around 4 %, so it's about a third tighter than normal. $ETH barely budged either, 1.13 % range versus a typical 2.76 %, also roughly a third tighter. $QNT was similarly quiet, moving only 12.24 % compared with its usual 33.79 % swing, again about a third of the norm. All three sat in a much tighter band today, nothing wild, just a calm day on the charts.

$BTC nudged up 0.26% to $84,810, held near the day-high of $85,037 and stayed above the $84,525 low. Volume was about 6.9k BTC, translating to roughly $588 M in quote volume.

$ETH crept 0.51% higher, finishing at $2,692.93 after testing $2,696.54 and never dropping past $2,672.34. Traders moved around 72.7k ETH, about $195 M in quote flow.

$BNB outperformed the pack, jumping 1.95% to $783.87, slicing through a $792.82 peak and a $764.83 floor. It swapped hands 99.3k times, pulling in $77.5 M of quote volume.

Watch the $BNB order-book depth as it approaches the $792 resistance; any shift could clue in on the next move.

$SAND surged 20.4% to $0.07416, blasting past its $0.06112 low and hitting $0.08396 high on heavy volume. $PUMP followed, up 18.3% to $0.00630, swinging between $0.00520 and $0.00649 with solid turnover. Meanwhile $ETH barely budged, inching up 0.7% to $2,683.6, staying inside a tight $2,657-$2,690 range despite the biggest quote volume of the group. Gains on the cheap alt side, while the big-cap stayed flat.
